decks.name: LeetCode #53 - Maximum Subarray
decks.description: Find the contiguous subarray with the largest sum

cards.question: Maximum Subarray: Given an integer array nums, find the contiguous subarray (containing at least one number) which has the largest sum and return its sum.

solutions.name: Kadane's Algorithm
solutions.explanation: Iterate through array tracking current sum and maximum sum. If current sum becomes negative, reset it to zero as starting fresh is better. Update maximum at each step. Most efficient greedy approach.
